arpit: Quick Q — need a short answer on how the chat/completions endpoint should encode tool/function calls when streaming. Specifically: a) shape during streaming deltas, b) final tool_response event, c) backward-compat for clients expecting `function_call`.

kate: Short answer: keep tool calls as a top-level `tool_call` object inside message deltas. During streaming, emit a `tool_call.delta` event with partial `args` as a string. After tool finishes, emit `tool_response.end` with full response.

zach: Can we avoid breaking `function_call` users? Suggest a shim: if client requests v2, runtime renames `tool_call` -> `function_call` for that response and sets header `x-schema-compat: function_call`. Minimal runtime overhead.

olivia: Implementation notes: `args` should be a single string while streaming; clients reassemble. Require `tool_call.name` (string), `tool_call.id` (uuid), `tool_call.args` (string | null).

arpit: Agree on id — critical for reassembly. Also propose delta envelope `event_type` values: `message.delta`, `tool_call.delta`, `tool_response.delta`, `tool_response.end`. Keep the shape explicit so SDKs can switch on event_type.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: rolling rollout started for `convo-schema/v3` to canary (us-west-2) — no config changes required for SDKs.

kate: Backward compat: if client sends `Accept: convo-schema=2` we should transform server output to v2 shape (rename `tool_call` -> `function_call`). Document in changelog and add automated tests in the compatibility suite.

zach: Edge case: nested toolcalls (tool triggers tool). Keep id sequencing: parent_id -> child_id; stream events interleave but include `parent_id` on child events so reassembly can build the tree.

olivia: Also specify token streaming: use `delta.content` for normal text tokens and `delta.args` string append for tool args. Example streaming fragment (note args are JSON escaped inside the string): ```json
{ "event_type": "tool_call.delta", "tool_call": { "id": "abc-123", "name": "search", "args": "{\"q\": \"latest release notes\"}" } }
``` Small note: runtime must preserve arg string order and not chunk in the middle of unicode codepoints.

arpit: Action items: @kate write the compatibility transform PR, @zach add reassembly util to SDKs, @olivia add interleaving/nested testcases. If no objections I'll add a one-paragraph RFC to the convo contract doc. Anyone object?

kate: :thumbsup: will do, ETA EOD tomorrow.

zach: I'll sketch the reassembly helper today and drop a prototype in the sdk-utils repo.

olivia: Adding tests now, will link PR when ready.

arpit: Thanks all — closing this thread. If anything new, ping #eng-platform and I'll reopen.
